fields.description: Pet record 1 status flags; bit0 = slot occupied, bits 0x100/0x200 tested by game loops
fields.evidence: FUN_08007c5c clears (DAT_08007d14 + slot*0x14)+0..+5 at init; FUN_08005024 counts (*(ushort*)(DAT_080054cc + (i+1)*0x14) & 1) over 100 slots; loops bound 0x65 test record+0 bits &1, &0x100 (DAT_080081e4 use) and &0x200; save-file slot1 at 0x14 reads 0x0000 (empty).
fields.name: pet1_flags

fields.description: Pet record 1 kind/species index byte, used as a table index by game code
fields.evidence: Record byte at +4 consumed as index (*(byte*)(DAT_080081e4 + slot*0x14 + 4)); slot stride 0x14 and init cleared by FUN_08007c5c; save-file slot1+4 at 0x18 reads 0x00 (empty).
fields.name: pet1_kind

fields.description: Pet record 1 stat word at +0x0C, initialized to 1990 (0x07C6) for every slot
fields.evidence: FUN_08007c5c stores (short)DAT_08007e10 at (DAT_08007e0c + slot*0x14 + 0x0C); baseline holds 0x07C6 (1990) at save offset 0x20 and at every empty slot +0x0C.
fields.name: pet1_stat_c

fields.description: Pet record 1 option byte at +0x0E, initialized to 1 for every slot
fields.evidence: FUN_08007c5c stores 1 at (DAT_08007e0c + slot*0x14 + 0x0E) (and +0x0F); save-file slot1+0x0E at 0x22 reads 0x01.
fields.name: pet1_opt_e

fields.description: 16-byte lead block (B1) of the 638-byte mid region: ff ff ff header plus zeros
fields.evidence: Block size 0x10 matches the FUN_08005b94 SRAM dual-write pair sizes (0x10, 600, 0x10, 4 + 2-byte global = 638); block pair written by FUN_0807d2a0 from one RAM source to two SRAM destinations; mirrored at save offset 0x1246.
fields.name: mid_b1_header

fields.description: Leading word (1000 in baseline) of the trailing 16-byte save block B3 of the mid region
fields.evidence: Block size 0x10 matches a FUN_08005b94 SRAM dual-write pair (same RAM source, two SRAM destinations via FUN_0807d2a0); load path FUN_08005024 verifies the same block via FUN_0807d2ec/FUN_0807d2f0; mirrored at save offset 0x14AE.
fields.name: mid_b3_value

fields.description: 4-byte trailer stamp (d2 07 01 1f) of the mid region, written by the save-init path
fields.evidence: FUN_08005a8c init sequence stores (short)DAT_08005b88 then byte +1 = 1 and byte +3 = 0x1F at DAT_08005b84, matching bytes d2 07 01 1f; persisted by the FUN_08005b94 4-byte dual-write pair; mirrored at save offset 0x14BE.
fields.name: mid_b4_stamp

fields.description: Mirror copy of pet record 1 status flags (redundant backup of the same logical field)
fields.evidence: Redundant mirror: FUN_08005b94 writes every save block from one RAM source to two SRAM destinations (FUN_0807d2a0 pairs); FUN_08005024 load loop tries copy index 0 then 1; bytes identical to pet1_flags in baseline.
fields.name: pet1_flags_copy

fields.description: Mirror copy of pet record 1 kind/species index byte
fields.evidence: Redundant mirror of the record table (table bytes 0x0000..0x07E3 identical to 0x0A62..0x1245 in baseline); written by FUN_08005b94 dual-write pairs; load tries both copies in FUN_08005024.
fields.name: pet1_kind_copy

fields.description: Mirror copy of pet record 1 stat word at +0x0C (1990 in baseline)
fields.evidence: Redundant mirror of the record table; FUN_08007c5c init value (short)DAT_08007e10 observed as 0x07C6 at this offset; dual-write persistence via FUN_08005b94.
fields.name: pet1_stat_c_copy

fields.description: Mirror copy of pet record 1 option byte at +0x0E (1 in baseline)
fields.evidence: Redundant mirror of the record table; FUN_08007c5c init value 1 observed at this offset; dual-write persistence via FUN_08005b94.
fields.name: pet1_opt_e_copy

fields.description: Mirror copy of the 16-byte lead block B1 of the mid region
fields.evidence: Redundant mirror: mid-region bytes 0x07E4..0x0A61 identical to 0x1246..0x14C3 in baseline; written by FUN_08005b94 dual-write pairs via FUN_0807d2a0.
fields.name: mid_b1_header_copy

fields.description: Mirror copy of the leading word (1000) of save block B3
fields.evidence: Redundant mirror via FUN_08005b94 dual-write pair; bytes identical to mid_b3_value in baseline; covered by the copy1 sum16 checksum.
fields.name: mid_b3_value_copy

fields.description: Mirror copy of the 4-byte trailer stamp (d2 07 01 1f)
